title: Shoplifting
grade_or_penalty: Graded by value: 2nd degree $75,000+; 3rd degree $500 to under $75,000; 4th degree $200 to $500; disorderly persons under $200. Shopping cart removal is a separate lesser offense
key_points: Taking or concealing merchandise, altering price tags, or transferring merchandise between containers with purpose to deprive the merchant.
Merchants and officers may detain a suspect in a reasonable manner for a reasonable time with probable cause.
Mandatory community service for shoplifting convictions.
